label: input token "1"
explanation: Token detector for the digit 1 as the current input. It fires on every step where the input is 1 (dev precision 1.0, recall 0.999), in both the original phase and the copy phase (when 1 comes back as a fed-back output). It never fires on the <DEL> step or on any other letter or digit, apart from about 100 very weak activations (about 0.15 of max) on the input s at step 8 of length-9 sequences. Magnitude is not checked quantitatively; going by the examples it is usually around 0.6-0.7 of max, and the highest activations (about 0.97-1.0) come when 1 is the last original token just before <DEL> in long sequences. Lift by first_tok and n_digits only reflects how often 1 appears in the sequence.
